# Gridfinity Anylid

Snap-on, stackable lid for Gridfinity bins of any size (fractional units supported).

- Source: supplied by the repository owner on 2026-10-03 (originally published on MakerWorld; listed on gridfinity.perplexinglabs.com as "Gridfinity Anylid").
- File kept byte-for-byte as supplied. The site renders `adapters/anylid/anylid.scad`, which fixes a magnet/screw-hole bug (see its header).
- License: not stated in the file. Confirm the MakerWorld page's license before public use.
